limitations.summary: Multi-Scale Feature Fusion The Multi-Branch Auxiliary FPN (MAFPN) [36], [37] addresses standard FPN limitations through bidirectional and multi-path connections preserving fine-grained spatial cues and high-level semantic abstractions.
items: Multi-Scale Feature Fusion The Multi-Branch Auxiliary FPN (MAFPN) [36], [37] addresses standard FPN limitations through bidirectional and multi-path connections preserving fine-grained spatial cues and high-level semantic abstractions.

The three benchmarks use incompatible label spaces-BTSD annotates 15 fine-grained sign classes, whereas CCTSDB2021 and GTSDB annotate three and four super-classes respectively-so a single model cannot be evaluated across them without a label-space unification that alters the detection task itself.
We therefore treat cross-dataset transfer as a separate study and report it as a limitation of this work.

deploymentClaims: Despite significant progress in real-time object detection, accurately identifying traffic signs under challenging conditions remains difficult.
